title: Section 142 NI Act — Cognizance of offences

content.overview: Section 142 restricts cognizance of section 138 offences to written complaints by the payee or holder in due course, filed within one month of the cause of action under the proviso to section 138, before a Metropolitan Magistrate or a Judicial Magistrate of the first class, with rules on territorial jurisdiction and successive presentation.
content.study: Cognizance is complaint-based, not police-charge-sheet based. Compute limitation from the day after the fifteen-day notice period expires. Amendments address where the cheque is delivered for collection and allow one trial for multiple cheques in specified circumstances. Pair with sections 138 and 141 for maintainability.
